item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dl0RD66hgaI

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握《古劍》最新線下試玩的完整流程、隱藏 Boss 與核心機制細節。
  • 深入了解採用虛幻引擎 5 的頂級畫質表現與經典情懷配樂的聽覺體驗。
  • 剖析硬核「類魂」戰鬥難度對系列傳統休閒及女性玩家所造成的門檻與衝擊。

摘要

線下試玩初體驗與驚喜隱藏關卡

作者親自參與了國產單機動作遊戲《古劍》的線下試玩活動，每位玩家擁有 60 分鐘的體驗時間。在完成序章教學後，現場提供四個戰鬥關卡供選擇，包含機制探索與三場純 Boss 戰。令人驚喜的是，在作者順利通關四個階段後，介面上解鎖了第五場隱藏戰鬥，該 Boss 正是序章出現且立於展台中央的巨大頭部。

虛幻引擎5打造的視聽盛宴與類魂氣息

作者指出，雖然官方極力將其與類魂遊戲區分，但實際體驗時從探索規則到戰鬥機制，皆散發出強烈的類魂風格，難免令人與《黑神話：悟空》及《明末》進行對比。在虛幻引擎 5的加持下，畫面精緻且幀率流暢，畫質表現堪比《黑神話》，經典地圖的現代重製亦極具細節。同時，展台播放的經典配樂《千秋》瞬間喚醒老玩家的 DNA，展現出系列一貫頂級的音樂靈魂。

高難度戰鬥對傳統客群的衝擊與解方思考

作者對遊戲的難度曲線深感憂慮。試玩難度直逼《黑神話》，戰鬥仰賴極其嚴格的精準格擋與及時閃避，第三關 Boss 更因傷害高、判定嚴格且無法召喚援助，成為許多玩家的噩夢，作者也歷經三次嘗試才擊敗它。考慮到《古劍》擁有龐大的女性與劇情向休閒客群，現場已有不少玩家頻繁「撞牆受苦」。作者擔心過高的硬核門檻會勸退休閒玩家並將其推向「雲玩家」陣營，因此呼籲官方未來能加入劇情模式難度，或建議休閒玩家選擇 PC 版輔助通關，以確保龐大玩家群體能享受故事，同時這也將引發單機動作遊戲是否該向玩家妥協難度的持續討論。

================================================

I participated in an offline demo of. the domestic single-player action game,. Gujian. The content of this demo was. basically the same as the one held in. July, with each player getting 60. minutes of playtime. After the prologue. tutorial, there were four battles to. choose from; the first included an. exploration segment to familiarize you. with the mechanics, while the following. three were pure boss fights. After. successfully completing the four demo. stages, a fifth secret battle actually. appeared on the interface, and the. fifth boss was the same as the one in. the prologue: this giant head in the. center of the booth. So, how does this.

highly anticipated domestic. single-player game perform? First,. although the game repeatedly. differentiates itself from the. Souls-like genre, playing it, you are. still greeted by a very strong "Souls" vibe. Whether it's the exploration. rules or the combat mechanics, it's. hard not to compare it with*Black Myth*. and*Mingmo*. In terms of visual. performance, thanks to Unreal Engine 5,. and running the game in the. manufacturer's recommended hardware. environment, the visuals are incredibly. polished, and the frame rate is. remarkably smooth. I believe the image. quality presented in the demo is on par.

with*Black Myth*, and with the modern. recreation of the series 'classic map,. it feels very detailed to me. Music is. especially important for the Gujian. series; the series originally gained. popularity through its story and. characters, and the BGM is the soul of. the franchise—even the Gujian TV. drama series used music from the games. The background music at the demo booth. was very loud, playing the track " Qianqiu" which triggers the DNA of. Gujian players, clearly intending to. reassure fans that they don't need to. worry about the game's audio quality. However, what I am concerned about is. the game itself, especially the.

difficulty curve. Here I have to. mention three domestic action games: *. Black Myth*and*Mingmo*both have a high. barrier to entry, especially*Mingmo*. which had imbalanced combat stats at. launch, while the upcoming*Phantom. Blade Zero*has difficulty adjustment. options and supports switching settings. on the fly. After playing Gujian, I. feel the demo difficulty is comparable. to*Black Myth*; this difficulty is fine. for seasoned action game players, but. the Gujian IP is unique. It has a. massive following in domestic gaming,. including a large female player base,. and there were many female players in. line for this demo. From my.

observations, it's inevitable that. players will "hit a wall," especially. in the third demo stage. The booth is. actually built to resemble the scene. from that stage, which seems to be a. key focus the game's story wants to. highlight. It’s not some random boss; he deals high damage, has strict hit. detection, and features wide-range. unblockable moves. Since you can’t. summon help during this fight, he’s. become a nightmare for many players—. it took me three tries to take him down. . Combat in this installment requires. precise parries or timely dodges. Parrying consumes stamina, so while. engaging the boss, you also have to.

find openings to use items. A single. mistake can lead to significant damage,. marking a massive shift from the core. gameplay of previous entries. Once the. game launches, casual players drawn in. by the story might easily get. discouraged, and their feedback could. potentially deter developers from. focusing on the narrative in future. titles. If everyone ends up just. watching the story online because the. entry barrier is too high, that. certainly isn’t a good thing for the. game’s development. However, there. are ways to address this if the team. decides to adapt. Based on the user. base of the series, it’s rumored that.

adjustable difficulty might be added. post-launch, but this isn't confirmed,. and we don't know the actual range of. the difficulty settings. I hope they. provide a "story mode" difficulty so. that casual players who just want to. follow the characters' fates can enjoy. the game, which would also help promote. the series IP once again. After all, it. has been a very long time since the. previous title was released. Secondly,. casual users can choose to buy the PC. version, allowing them to use trainers. for "one-hit kills" and experience the. story smoothly. This is a familiar. approach for the previous three games. in the series. In any case, whether.

single-player action games should. compromise on difficulty to accommodate. users is a debate that will surely. continue to be heated in the future. Yeah.

=============

for her release. the east of the military base,. there’s an area marked with an. airship icon, which is the launch site. for weather blimps. area, but it’s not an airport—it's. the first professional racetrack in the. series. here. item.itunes:summary:

值得閱讀的理由

  • 詳細盤點《GTA 6》終極版比標準版昂貴 120 美元的各項專屬內容，評估其整體性價比。
  • 揭示多項經典元素回歸，包含《罪惡都市》維賽堤豪宅專屬左輪手槍、獵豹跑車以及線上模式機制的單人化。
  • 深入分析終極版獨佔的幫派突襲與經典老車尋寶修復任務，以及專屬可進入的實體設施。

摘要

終極版情懷滿載的專屬載具與傳奇武器

作者指出，《GTA 6》終極版售價比標準版高出 120 多美元，為此逐一檢視其額外內容是否物有所值。首先是極具情懷的 95 年款獵豹（Cheetah）跑車，致敬了《罪惡都市》中臥底警察的專屬座駕。武器方面更具吸引力，包含來自《罪惡都市》主角維賽堤豪宅的傳奇霍克左輪手槍，時隔 20 年再度回歸，以及刻有兩位主角名字的專屬客製武器。此外，終極版還附贈曾於線上模式登場的 Enduro 越野摩托車，以及引入《荒野大鏢客》手動划船機制的全新載具皮划艇。

單人模式升級與專屬室內設施

在車輛與生活設施方面，終極版改善了主角原本破舊的預設座駕外觀，並首度將線上模式備受歡迎的低底盤改裝工坊移植為單人模式專屬的「Lowrider Street」改裝店。遊戲還為終極版玩家開放了可實際進入的美容沙龍（系列作首次支援女性美甲）、專屬刺青店與越野車改裝店。載具部分則新增了可攜帶潛水裝備出海浮潛的特製快艇，畫面中更首度出現了美國海岸警衛隊船隻；而配有槍櫃與違禁品藏匿處的新車庫，亦預示著線上模式的藏匿系統正式進駐單人劇情。

獨佔任務與高價版本的總體衡量
